code:
version: prometheus/v1
service: {{service_name}}
labels:
  team: platform
slos:
  - name: availability
    objective: {{objective}}
    description: '{{service_name}} 99x availability over {{window}}'
    sli:
      events:
        error_query: sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="{{service_name}}",code=~"5.."}[5m]))
        total_query: sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="{{service_name}}"}[5m]))
    alerting:
      page_alert: { labels: { severity: page } }
      ticket_alert: { labels: { severity: ticket } }
summary_zh: sloth 風格 SLO,含 SLI query 與 multi-window alert
